messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — I'm posting the draft Rate Card v3.2 in the drive. Main changes: adjusted commit bands, new "starter" SKU for lower-volume PLG accounts, and clarified grandfathering for legacy commits. Need deal-desk sign-off on two exception flows and confirmation of APAC list pricing before we publish. https://docs.redwood.com/ratecards/3.2-draft :eyes:

priya: Thanks Sarah. Can you drop the list of active commits that would be affected? I need customer names + current commit bands to run impact calc.

sarah: Yep — short list below (just highlights):
```
Customer, Current Commit, Region
NimbusHealth, 250k/mo, NA
FathomAI, 100k/mo, APAC
ArcForms, 50k/mo, EU
BetaPilot (POC), n/a (trial), NA
```

priya: Perfect. Can you also confirm any negotiated discounts tied to those commits? We need that to compute uplift and whether this triggers a grandfather exception.

sarah: NimbusHealth has a pre-2024 grandfather at 10% off list, FathomAI got a one-time 15% POC concession (APAC), ArcForms on standard enterprise 5% — BetaPilot is on demo credits only.

mike: Two quick notes: 1) If we move the lower bound for the 100k->250k band, that will change billing calculations for Nimbus. 2) APAC list pricing needs FX adjustment — add a 3% region premium unless finance says otherwise.

tom: For BetaPilot (POC) — can we give a short-term onboarding discount outside the rate card? Sales asks for a 60-day POC promo to convert. What's required from deal desk to approve that?

priya: Short answer: deal-desk approval + documented revenue estimate + GL code for promo. For exceptions < $10k ARR we can ok in-thread; above that we need formal approval from RevOps. Please include expected conversion rate and ARR impact.

sarah: Got it. I'll add ARR estimates and expected conversion. Quick ask: does Legal need to review the wording for the grandfather clause? jess?

jess: Yes — if we're changing grandfathering semantics we need to add a one-sentence amendment to the MSA or append an addendum for pre-existing commits. I can draft the clause but need a sample customer-facing paragraph and list of affected contracts.

priya: One more operational thing: for customers moving to the new "starter" SKU (mainly PLG churners), do we want to automatically migrate them or make it opt-in? Ops prefers opt-in, finance prefers auto for billing simplicity. Thoughts?

mike: I'd vote opt-in for the first 90 days, then auto for anything that doesn't respond — gives CS time to communicate. Also we should flag any auto move with a billing notification email.

sarah: Proposed flow: opt-in pilot for 90 days -> automation rollback window -> auto move + notice. Will document.

priya: Approvals workflow: I can provisionally approve the rate card language and starter SKU rules pending: (a) final APAC list price confirmation from Finance, (b) ARR impact spreadsheet, (c) Legal clause for grandfathering. If those arrive before EOD Friday I can sign off. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Ticket created: RDO-2034 — "Rate Card v3.2 deal-desk review" (assignee: priya). https://pm.redwood.com/RDO-2034

sarah: Thanks — I'll upload the ARR spreadsheet and attach the customer contract list to the ticket.

tom: For POCs — if we keep the 60-day promo cap at $5k ACV we can approve faster. Can we do $5k as a standard limit?

priya: Yes, $5k ACV cap works for ad-hoc POC concessions. Above that need RevOps sign-off. I'll add that to the exception policy doc.

jess: I'll draft a short addendum and drop it into the drive — ping me if you want a tracked-change version.

sarah: Great — plan is to collect the three artifacts and coordinate final sign-off. Will ping again once ARR sheet is in. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

priya: Marking as provisional approve — will move to final after finance confirmation.

mike: FYI — I'll run the APAC FX calc and post results here by tomorrow morning.

sarah: Appreciated.
